name: Ryuji Arai
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026)
forbes_bio: Ryuji Arai started Bic Camera, the electronics and appliances retailing giant, in 1978.
The company posted over $6 billion in revenue in the fiscal year through August 2025.
Arai also owns stakes in temporary staffing firm Hit Communications Holdings and contact lens-maker Seed.
forbes_facts: Bic Camera owns a majority stake in listed satellite TV network Nippon BS Broadcasting.

name: Stefania Triva
forbes_bio: Stefania Triva is CEO and the largest shareholder of Italy-based Copan, one of the world's largest producers of flocked swabs for diagnostic tests.
Founded in 1979 by her father, Giorgio, Copan initially distributed lab products and started to make swabs in 1982, when her brother Daniele joined the firm.
Daniele succeeded Giorgio after his death in 2002; in 2003, he invented flocked swabs, which collect more sample material than regular cotton Q-tips.
Stefania took over as CEO after Daniele's death in 2014; the Covid-19 pandemic led to a dramatic surge in demand for Copan's products.
Flocked swabs made up more than 80% of Copan's $445 million revenues in 2021; the firm also makes machines and software that automate diagnostics.

name: Anant Asavabhokin
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2019); Hurun Global (2014-2021)
forbes_bio: Thai property tycoon Anant Asavabhokin's biggest asset is a stake in SET-listed Land And Houses.
He founded the company with his mother, Piangjai Harnpanij, in 1983. The company is known for its focus on semi-detached houses.
The Covid-19 pandemic hit the company's rental income but saw an increase in the sale of semi-detached houses and townhouses.
In 2021, the company acquired SpringHill Suites by Marriott, a 120-rooom hotel in California for $31 million.
forbes_facts: In 2017, he resigned from the chairmanship of four of his companies over money laundering charges. He denied any wrongdoing.

name: Peng Qian
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Hurun China (2015-2026); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Peng Qian is the founder and chairman of Wuhan Jingce Electronic Group, a manufacturer of testing equipment in the semiconductor, display and new energy industries.
Before founding the company, Peng worked in market sales at Guangzhou ASPEC Environmental Instruments, a Chinese environmental testing equipment manufacturer.
Wuhan Jingce Electronic Group listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2016.

name: Yang Xuegang
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2010-2026)
forbes_bio: Yang Xuegang is the chairman and CEO of China Risun Group, a supplier of coke and chemicals.
Founded in 1995, China Risunis headquartered in Beijing.
Yang Xuegangworked at the Dongwushi Reservoir Management Center-- under a government water bureau -- earlier in his career.
Yang Xuegang holds an executive master's degree in business administration from Hebei University of Technology in Tianjin.

name: Sergey Shnayder
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026)
forbes_bio: Sergey Shnayder is the founder of Svetofor Group, a discount supermarket chain in Russia.
Svetofor Group has more than 2,000 supermarkets under the Svetofor and Mayak brands.
Shnayder got his start in the 1990s as a distributor of beer and low-alcoholic beverages.
In 2004, with partners, Shnayder started a new business, launching a chain of stores that primarily sold beer.

name: Zhang Guiping
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2008-2023); Hurun Global (2014-2022); Hurun China (2006-2023)
forbes_bio: Zhang Guiping is the chairman of Suning Universal, a property and hotel business headquartered in Nanjing, a city in eastern China.
Zhang has been working to diversify Shenzhen-listed Suning with investments in cosmetic surgery, hospitals and health insurance companies.
Zhang's brother Zhang Jindong is also a billionaire.
